description.value: The Anchor Riverfront Motel is a two-storey, 16-room motel situated along the Eagle River at the eastern entrance to Sicamous on the Trans-Canada Highway, midway between Vancouver and Calgary. In addition to standard motel rooms, the property offers a campground at the back with tenting sites, RV spaces, an outdoor kitchen with BBQ, and washroom/shower facilities. Sicamous sits at the junction of Mara and Shuswap lakes with over 700 hiking and biking trails in the surrounding area, making this a practical overnight stop for Highway 1 touring cyclists.

address.value: 1321 Trans Canada Highway, Sicamous, BC, V0E 2V0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at anchormotel.ca is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. The /reserve/ page explicitly lists 'Laundry Facilities' and 'Free wireless internet' among motel/campground amenities, confirming those two items. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the site; those fields are null by absence-of-evidence rules. Contact details (phone, address) match OSM exactly.
